description: Request context compaction at the next safe tool boundary. Call at a natural phase boundary when (1) a sub-task is finished and raw tool output is no longer needed verbatim, (2) the conversation switched to an unrelated topic, or (3) a long multi-step stretch is about to start and context is already past half the auto-compress threshold. Do not call mid-edit or mid-debug when exact recent output matters, right after compaction, to tidy a small context, or more than once per phase. Always pass focus naming decisions, open items, file paths, and IDs to preserve. Not supported on codex_app_server because native thread compaction cannot accept focus guidance.
name: compact_context

focus.description: Optional decisions, open items, paths, and IDs the summary must preserve.

reason.description: Short reason this is a natural compaction boundary.
